SCRIPT_EXEC.description: Execute a Python script in a sandboxed environment with tool access (bash/list/read/write/diff/search/web)

params.timeout_ms: number (optional, default 30000) - execution timeout in milliseconds
params.max_memory_mb: number (optional, default 256) - maximum memory usage in MB

tool_surface.tools.bash_exec: Execute shell command; stdout is auto-truncated for long output
tool_surface.tools.read_file: Read file with optional line range (max 200 lines per call)
tool_surface.tools.write_file: Write or append file content (max 1MB per call)
tool_surface.tools.apply_diff: Apply unified diff text to a file
tool_surface.tools.search_files: Regex search across files, returns grep-style matches
tool_surface.tools.fetch_webpage: Fetch HTTPS webpage and return cleaned markdown

response.tool_calls_log: array - log of tool calls made during execution
